# Test fixtures

Tests never touch the network. Providers are swapped for `tests/helpers/providers.ts`.

- `nhtsa/`: **real recordings** from NHTSA vPIC (`DecodeVinValues`) and the recalls API
  (`recallsByVehicle`), captured 2026-11-12. The VINs are made up, so vPIC reports
  ErrorCode 1 (check digit) on most of them; that is realistic and exercised in tests.
- `marketcheck/`: **synthetic**, generated by `scripts/make-marketcheck-fixtures.ts` in the
  documented response shape. Replace with real recordings via `npm run fixtures:record`
  once `MARKETCHECK_API_KEY` is set (the recorder strips the key and VINs).
